project_type: Benchmark/ops repo (bash + python) driving LLM serving benchmarks on remote B300 GPU EC2. This task is LIVE-INSTANCE OPS driven entirely over AWS SSM send-command, not local code development.
language: bash + python (orchestration); vLLM (nightly) is the system under test on the remote instance
build_system: No build. Deliverable is a benchmark run + markdown summary in docs/run-summaries/.
test_framework: N/A for this task (repo has tests/run-tests.sh for its shell scripts, but this task adds no shell scripts to the repo, only a summary doc and SSM-driven ops).
test_command: N/A (verification is: proxy /health 200 + all 5 bench concurrency levels produce result JSON with 0 failed requests)
verification_instructions: 1) prefill instance (:8100) and decode instance (:8200) each return /health 200 with gpumem>0 on their 4 GPUs. 2) proxy on :30080 /health 200. 3) A smoke /v1/chat/completions through :30080 returns a valid completion. 4) All 5 bench levels (c=1,2,4,8,16) produce /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd/c{C}.json with completed==num_prompts and failures==0.
setup_instructions: Instance already running with model + image present. Access ONLY via: aws ssm send-command --region us-west-2 --instance-ids i-07a1fb189f180ff3e --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters 'commands=[...]' --query Command.CommandId --output text ; poll with aws ssm get-command-invocation --region us-west-2 --command-id <ID> --instance-id i-07a1fb189f180ff3e. Long-running steps (starting servers, bench) MUST be backgrounded with nohup + logfile + tail-poll, or use --timeout-seconds, because they exceed send-command default execution timeout.
environment_constraints: Network mode for the sandbox host: only the connected GitHub repo is reachable. ALL GPU/serving work happens on the remote B300 via SSM. No interactive SSM session (session-manager-plugin absent; start-session blocked). Security group tpot-bench-noingress-sg has NO ingress; public endpoint unreachable => all serving+bench run on the instance's loopback (127.0.0.1). DO NOT stop the instance or DELETE any booking (irreversible teardown is handled by the orchestrator after results).
contribution_requirements: No PR/push required. Output is a report back to the orchestrator plus an optional summary doc committed locally at docs/run-summaries/b300-vllm-pd-4p4d-20260913-summary.md (parallel to the existing b300-vllm-nvfp4-dspark-20260913-summary.md).
key_patterns: PREVIOUS TP8 RUN (baseline to beat on TPOT/ITL): image vllm/vllm-openai:nightly (vLLM 0.29.1rc1.dev9), model /opt/dlami/nvme/models/nvidia__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-nvfp4-DSpark, served-model-name dsv4-nvfp4-dspark. Required flags proven working: --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 (mandatory for DeepSeek-V4 fp8_ds_mla KV) --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4 --enable-auto-tool-choice --max-model-len 133120 ; env -e VLLM_USE_V1=1 -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=... ; DSpark spec decode --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"greedy"}'. Container run flags: --network host --ipc host --shm-size 32g -v /opt/dlami/nvme:/opt/dlami/nvme -v hfcache:/root/.cache/huggingface. NVFP4 MoE (TRT-LLM fused MoE + UE8M0 DeepGEMM) auto-activates on B300. KV CONNECTOR GATE ALREADY PASSED on the image: nixl installed (nixl_agent OK), NixlConnector registered in KVConnectorFactory. Reference NIXL disagg proxy at /vllm-workspace/examples/disaggregated/lmcache/disagg_prefill_lmcache_v1/disagg_proxy_server.py is model-agnostic and reusable as-is (sends prefill req with max_tokens=1, then streams from decoder). NIXL side channel: env VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT (default 5600) must be UNIQUE per instance; VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST default localhost. UCX_TLS=cuda_ipc,cuda_copy,tcp for intra-node NVLink transfer. BENCH GOTCHA: this nightly rejects --random-range-ratio 1.0; use --random-range-ratio 0.0 for fixed 40k input.
relevant_files: docs/run-summaries/b300-vllm-nvfp4-dspark-20260913-summary.md (previous TP8 run, the baseline + exact working flags)
docs/b300-pd-3p1d-plan-review.md (prior SGLang 3P1D plan, conceptual only; that stack differs - vLLM NIXL here, not SGLang mooncake)
directory_structure: docs/run-summaries/ holds per-run markdown summaries; reports/ holds detailed report bundles; scripts/ holds the repo's own bench shell scripts (not modified by this task); infra/ has lambda capacity poller. The live instance holds: model at /opt/dlami/nvme/models/nvidia__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-nvfp4-DSpark, the running vllm-tp8 container, and the vllm-openai:nightly image with disagg examples baked in at /vllm-workspace/examples/disaggregated/.
